description:
Send a file (document, image, audio, video, contact) to a recipient via MAX, WhatsApp or Telegram (set the channel in dispatch_routing; SMS cannot carry files). File is uploaded as multipart/form-data. Images under 10MB sent natively, larger files as download links active for 7 days.

Use it when the user wants to share a document, photo, voice message, video or contact card. Provide the file as exactly one of: file_path (local file), file_url (downloaded by the server) or file_base64 (with file_name).

Supported: pdf, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, xls, xlsx, zip, 7z; ogg, opus, mp3, aac, amr, 3gp; jpeg, png, webp; mp4; vcf. Max 100 MB. Recipient: `phone`, or for personal Telegram (dispatch_routing ["tdlib"]) `username` or `tdlib_user_id` instead.

callback_url.description: URL that receives the final delivery status as a POST request (retried every 2 minutes, up to 10 times, until it returns HTTP 200).

dispatch_routing.description: Channels in the order ChatPush should try them (cascade: the next channel is used only if delivery through the previous one fails). whatsapp = WhatsApp, tdlib = personal Telegram account, telegram = Telegram Bot, notify = VK/OK, max = MAX messenger, sms = SMS. If omitted, the account's default routing is used.

external_id.description: Your client-side ID for this message (idempotency ID).

file_base64.description: File content as base64 (a data: URL is accepted too). Requires file_name.

file_name.description: Filename with extension, e.g. document.pdf. Defaults to the name from file_path or file_url.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local file to upload (~ is expanded).

file_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file; the server downloads and uploads it.

phone.description: Recipient phone in international format. Optional if username is used (tdlib).

priority.description: Sending priority. Chosen automatically if omitted.

reply_to_message_id.description: ID of the message to reply to, taken from an incoming-message webhook.

scheduled_at.description: Delayed sending time, format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in UTC+0. At least 1 minute and at most 1 month ahead.

sender_name.description: Registered SMS sender name (see get_balance → sender names).

simulate_typing.description: Default true: show a typing indicator in WhatsApp before sending. false sends instantly.

tdlib_user_id.description: Telegram user ID (positive = private chat, negative = group chat). tdlib channel only.

type.description: document = send as file, image = send as photo (WhatsApp/tdlib).

name: send_file
title: Send file
